caseNameFull: Shyman, doing business as Alaska Distributors Co. v. Fleming, Temporary Controls Administrator
attorneys: Daniel B. Trefethen for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman, Assistant Attorney General Quinn, Robert S. Erdahl and Philip R. Monahan for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion of the Solicitor General to substitute the United States of America as the party respondent is granted. Certiorari denied.
